book.author: Rudolf von Jhering
book.original_title: Der Kampf ums Recht / The Struggle for Law
book.edition: 1915 Chicago English second edition, John J. Lalor translation from German fifth edition (1872 original, publisher of 1872 printing not asserted); Albert Kocourek 1915 introduction is editorial

original_verification: 直接系统核对1915年Callaghan and Company英译第二版（J. J. Lalor自第五德文版翻译）的完整作者序言及全部六章：法律和平与斗争；具体权利的请求；对自身的义务；对社会的义务；与国家的关系；罗马法、程序及制裁。将第五版作者序言与1872年初次演讲区分，并剔除1915年Kocourek编者导论作为原著论证的归属。1872年德文首印出版社未经核验，未虚构。

critics.name: Neil Duxbury
critics.work: Jhering's Philosophy of Authority, Oxford Journal of Legal Studies 27(1) (2007)
critics.checked: 追问法律权威与法感情如何形成，反对仅将耶林作为后来利益法学先驱的简化解释

critics.name: Christoph-Eric Mecke
critics.work: Rudolf von Jhering's 'struggle for law' — the rejection of alternative forms of dispute resolution?, Transformacje Prawa Prywatnego 4 (2017)
critics.checked: 辨析原著允许善意争议和解，指出本书并不普遍否定替代性争端解决

critics.name: Josefa Birr
critics.work: Jhering's concept of Rechtsgefühl and its role in The Struggle for Law, Transformacje Prawa Prywatnego 4 (2017)
critics.checked: 辨析法感情、社会生活经验和具体权利争议，而非将其等同纯粹情绪

critics.name: Inge Kroppenberg and Nikolaus Linder
critics.work: Domestic trials, and The Struggle for Law, Transformacje Prawa Prywatnego 4 (2017)
critics.checked: 结合1864—1865年女佣工资诉讼档案考察耶林本人法律实践与思想关系

critics.name: Roger Cotterrell
critics.work: The struggle for law: some dilemmas of cultural legality, International Journal of Law in Context (2009)
critics.checked: 反思共同法律文化假设在多元社会及不平等权利经验中的限度
